determinism_note: This file intentionally contains no timestamp; SHA-256 is a function only of the registered inputs.

framework_implications.k0_status: Registered under K0.3 as a new forward prediction; the scope and threshold of K0 are unchanged. The failure clause above only adds a way for the framework to die.
framework_implications.not_a_rescue_of_P1: P1 stands as registered, with its editorial flag; P14 does not score or replace it.
framework_implications.on_failure: The GSC core (T1-T3) then has no registered content that distinguishes it from LCDM, and the conformal-reduction clause K0.4 applies: GSC is falsified as a distinct theory.

physics_status: Exact consequence of the early-transition reading for the registered q. Not a fit: CMB + BAO distance data do not constrain q (analyses/joint_fit.md).

epochs.note: neutron-proton freeze-out, T ~ 1 MeV (allowing for e+e- annihilation)

late_universe.note: Exactly 1 below the transition: no local drift, consistent with kill condition K2.

relation_between_epochs.note: ln(G/G0) at nucleosynthesis over ln(G/G0) at recombination; fixed by the transition shape for any q, so two measurements test the shape as well as the amplitude.

prediction.summary: G/G0 = 0.9921 at recombination (-0.79%) and 0.9702 at nucleosynthesis (-2.98%).

registered_parameters.q_provenance: Inherited from P1: the value for which the variant reproduces P1's registered BAO shift at fixed cosmological parameters (analyses/p_role_consistency.py).

scoring_rule.fail: |z| >= 3 at any scored epoch, or a fit of this one-parameter model excluding the registered q at >= 3 sigma.
scoring_rule.pass: |z| < 3 at every scored epoch, with at least one sigma <= |r_pred - 1|/2 (a measurement able to tell the prediction from G = G0).
scoring_rule.statistic: For each epoch with a published determination r_obs +/- sigma of G/G0 (1 sigma; for asymmetric errors the side facing the prediction) from an analysis that lets G at that epoch differ from today's: z = (r_pred - r_obs)/sigma.
scoring_rule.sub_threshold: |z| < 3 everywhere, but no measurement yet precise enough to tell the prediction from G = G0.

tier: T2 (coherent reading of the canonical exponent; OPEN_PROBLEMS.md problem 1)
